title: The Dying Magistrate
text: The old Magistrate is dying in a room that smells of camphor and rot, without an heir. His physicians whisper in the corridors that a House could have its own name read into the will, for the right gift and the right silence. He is not dying fast enough for some.

options.label: Send the physicians a gift, and say nothing.

outcomes.text: The will is read. Your House's name is in it, beside a mill and three streets.
The physicians took everyone's gift and buried the will with him.
Your House mourns him in public, which is more than most do, and the city notices.

together.text: No House bought the will. It leaves his coffers to the city itself.
Every House bribed a dying man. The whole city knows it by supper.
